description: Synthetic. Work group chat, three participants, missed deadline. Tests group addressing, pairing replies, workplace framing.

messages.text: The client deck was due at 10. Why am I only hearing now that it's not ready?
So sorry Priya, that's on me, I should have flagged it yesterday 🙏
The data from finance came in late. We can send a first version by 2pm and the full numbers tomorrow morning. Would that work?
This should never happen. I expect better from both of you.
Honestly it's not like we were sitting around. We've been working late all week.
Let's just get it done, I'll start on the slides now 😅
